blocks.text: Elevate the organization of your backyard patio with the Westwood Deck Storage Box from Keter. This versatile addition becomes a cornerstone in maintaining order and style in your outdoor space, offering enhanced functionality and aesthetics that complement your lifestyle.Maximize your outdoor spaces and contain your porch accessories, cushions, gardening tools, pool equipment, and more from harsh weather conditions. Constructed of durable plastic that resists various weather conditions, this outdoor storage box will become a staple in your lawn. With this heavy-duty container, you and your family can enjoy peace of mind, knowing that your outdoor accessories will stay dry and well-ventilated.Bring your patio decor to the next level and incorporate this elegant plastic rattan-style piece of furniture into your layout. Doubling as an outdoor storage bench, with a total weight capacity of 660 pounds, you and your partner can store away any extra furniture and sit together. Deck boxes by Keter feature an easy opening mechanism and a surface that is simple to clean, this storage organizer is convenient and will fit seamlessly into your everyday routine.Prioritize your balcony furniture and invest in a storage bin to keep your garden tools, pool accessories, and patio furniture secure with the Westwood Deck Storage Box from Keter.

items.label: LARGE OUTDOOR STORAGE BOX
items.value: Fashionably store your outdoor furniture cushions, pool floats, and more. This outdoor storage bench offers lots of convenient, lockable storage space and has enough room to seat 2 adults.

items.label: VERSATILE DECK BOX
items.value: This multipurpose outdoor storage container has a large interior with a 150-gallon storage capacity and gives you extra seating for those big backyard parties or a place to rest after working in your yard.

items.label: DURABLE & ATTRACTIVE RESIN CABINET
items.value: This deck storage box is attractive and rugged and is made from strong, durable resin with a wood-plank look. It has an easy-lift mechanism for an effortless open and a quiet close.

items.label: ALL-WEATHER-RESISTANT
items.value: The all-weather-resistant materials make this low-maintenance patio storage easy to use and enjoy for years to come. Unlike real wood, the thick exterior resin prevents rusting, peeling, and denting.

items.label: BETTER WITH KETER
items.value: We are driven to invent. We create lifestyle solutions for use in and around the home in ways that only we can. We design using sustainable and innovative technologies to create products that enhance people’s spaces and elevate their experiences.
